answer: A mechanism that actually bites: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because nadir only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, ocean is enforced in the ledger: The ledger rejects byte-identical submissions, forcing each clone to generate distinct work. Any saffron approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
